newsitem.title: FRANCE: French journalists want Palestinian newsman freed.
newsitem.headline: French journalists want Palestinian newsman freed.

text.p: A French media rights group asked President Yasser Arafat on Thursday to free Palestinian newsman Daoud Kuttab, winner of the International Press Freedom Award who is detained without charge by the Palestinian Authority.

"Reporters sans Frontieres (Reporters without Borders) protests against Daoud Kuttab's arrest...and asks you to use your influence to have him released," RSF wrote to the Palestinian leader in a letter circulated to the press.

The defence group said television broadcasts of Palestinian Legislative Council sessions by Kuttab had been jammed and he had accused authorities of this prior to his detention, saying they did not want the public to hear legislators criticising Arafat.
Kuttab, an East Jerusalem resident, was detained in the West Bank self-rule enclave of Ramallah on Tuesday.

Kuttab, who is also dean of the Modern Communications Centre at Jerusalem's al-Quds University, was awarded the International Press Freedom Award last year by the New York based Committee to Protect Journalists for his work challenging censorship practices of both Israeli and Palestinian authorities.
